body.surroundingContext: He counted the coins twice, then a third time, before he understood.

suggestions.text: His thumb rubbed the reeded edges, clicking each cold disc against his palm.
suggestions.label: Tactile rhythm

suggestions.text: He flipped the metal pieces again, a harsh clatter ringing sharp in the quiet.
suggestions.label: Auditory emphasis

suggestions.text: Fingers traced the tarnished faces as he sorted them, weighing the stack anew.
suggestions.label: Visual detail
